index.html.beforeText:
Q

Quantum Index

Source-aware map of fundamental physics.

FUNDAMENTAL PHYSICS ATLAS

Explore the ideas shaping modern physics.

Move through theories, equations, evidence, historical lineage and open research while keeping the source trail visible.

Search and filters update the Network map, Timeline and Catalog.

START WITH YOUR QUESTION

Choose how you want to explore fundamental physics

Move from scientific problems to competing approaches, equations, evidence, recent developments, research questions and primary literature.

WHAT'S NEW

Recent reviewed developments

Full development timeline

OPEN RESEARCH

Questions still requiring work

All open questions

Upstream and downstream show typed connections, not necessarily historical causation. The filter also applies to theory connections and thought trees.

RELATIONSHIP GRAPH

Ideas as a connected system

Drag nodes. Scroll to zoom. Select a node for lineage, status, overlaps and related ideas.

← Back to network map

ORIGINS + DEVELOPMENTS

Timeline of fundamental physics

Theory origins remain historical; later developments keep their own dates.

THOUGHT TREES

Major intellectual branches

Choose a branch. The map uses the catalog's actual typed relationships; it does not invent arrows between adjacent items.

PROGRESSION MAP

Thought tree

Horizontal position is chronological. Rows show primary catalog category. Arrows appear only for relationships explicitly stored in the index.

SELECTED LINEAGE

Choose a theory

Select a node to inspect its upstream ideas, downstream progression and overlaps.

INDEX

All catalogued theories

SCIENTIFIC PROBLEMS

Start with the question physics is trying to answer

Problems organize existing theories, formulas, evidence, developments and research questions without turning the problem itself into a theory.

EVIDENCE + CONSTRAINTS

What experiments and observations actually establish

Each record separates the measured result from the theories or parameter space it constrains—and from conclusions it does not establish.

RESEARCH QUESTIONS

What is established, conditional, model-specific or still open?

These records preserve the reviewed 59-question profile audit and add focused problem-level questions as new literature is reviewed. They are research-orientation summaries, not declarations that every prompt is an unsolved problem.

COMPARE APPROACHES

Explore the differences

Choose two to four entries. Compare their scope, assumptions, results and limitations. A source citation is not a verdict of experimental confirmation.

Permanent comparison link

CURATED RESEARCH GUIDES

Foundations, information and gravity

Expanded research profiles with suggested prerequisites. These reading suggestions are not additional historical connections in the graph.

EQUATION INDEX

Quantum formula atlas

Canonical equations, identities, bounds and model Hamiltonians linked back to the theories and sources that use them.

.github/workflows/validate.yml.beforeText:
name: Validate catalog

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  validate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Check JavaScript syntax
        run: |
          node --check app.js
          node --check theories.js
          node --check formulas.js
          node --check formula-audit.js
          node --check developments.js
          node --check questions.js
          node --check problems.js
          node --check evidence.js
          node --check passports.js
          node --check profiles.js
          node --check workspace.js
          node --check sourced-paths.js
          node --check research-navigation.js
      - name: Install test dependencies
        run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - name: Test navigation and catalog regressions
        run: npm test
      - name: Verify generated coverage
        run: |
          node scripts/coverage-report.mjs --check
          node scripts/freshness-report.mjs --check
          node scripts/version-assets.mjs --check
      - name: Validate theory graph
        run: node scripts/validate-data.mjs
      - name: Verify static entry point
        run: |
          test -f index.html
          test -f styles.css
          test -f developments.js
          test -f questions.js
          test -f problems.js
          test -f evidence.js
          test -f passports.js
          grep -q './theories.js' index.html
          grep -q './developments.js' index.html
          grep -q './questions.js' index.html
          grep -q './problems.js' index.html
          grep -q './evidence.js' index.html
          grep -q './passports.js' index.html
          grep -q './app.js' index.html
          grep -q './formulas.js' index.html
          grep -q './formula-audit.js' index.html
          grep -q './profiles.js' index.html
          grep -q 'id="formulaView"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="formulaGrid"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="thoughtTreeGraph"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="treeGraphTitle"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="timelineLayer"' index.html
          grep -q 'id="timelineEventType"' index.html
          grep -q 'function renderThoughtTreeGraph' app.js

  browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    # Full-catalog MathJax checks plus per-record Chromium/WebKit provenance tests.
    timeout-minutes: 35
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - run: npm ci --ignore-scripts
      - run: npx playwright install --with-deps chromium webkit
      - run: npm run test:browser
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        if: always()
        with:
          name: browser-report
          path: |
            playwright-report/
            test-results/
          retention-days: 14

  package:
    if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' && github.event_name != 'pull_request'
    needs: [validate, browser]
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    permissions:
      contents: read
      pages: read
    outputs:
      workflow_pages: ${{ steps.pages.outputs.workflow_pages }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Check Pages publishing source
        id: pages
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: |
          mode=$(gh api "repos/$GITHUB_REPOSITORY/pages" --jq .build_type)
          if [ "$mode" = workflow ]; then
            echo "workflow_pages=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "workflow_pages=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "Pages still uses branch publishing. Select Settings > Pages > Source > GitHub Actions to activate the tested-artifact deployment gate." >> "$GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY"
          fi
      - name: Package the tested revision
        run: |
          mkdir _site
          cp index.html styles.css theories.js formulas.js formula-audit.js developments.js questions.js problems.js evidence.js passports.js profiles.js workspace.js sourced-paths.js research-navigation.js app.js _site/
          cp -R docs _site/docs
          printf '%s\n' "$GITHUB_SHA" > _site/revision.txt
      - uses: actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3
        with:
          path: _site

  deploy:
    needs: package
    if: needs.package.outputs.workflow_pages == 'true'
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    concurrency:
      group: pages
      cancel-in-progress: false
    permissions:
      pages: write
      id-token: write
    environment:
      name: github-pages
      url: ${{ steps.deployment.outputs.page_url }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/deploy-pages@v4
        id: deployment
